1 Responsive tile grid (auto-fill, ~520px minimum): 1 column when narrow, 2 or 3 as the page widens. Tile header = collapse chevron, project name, count, distribution bar, legend ('{count} {Status name}').
2 Inside a tile: status pill + count in a left gutter, rows to the right, first 5 per status then 'Show N more'. Collapsed tiles keep the bar, so 'Collapse all' is the overview.
3 Row = state icon, one-line title, repo#number (owner dropped unless ambiguous), time since update. No labels in this version.
4 Sidebar toggle « / »: collapsed by default, remembered, works in List and Group-by-project alike. Collapsed it is an icon rail, so Assigned / Created / Mentioning stay one click away.
